questions.text: I _____ won the prize.
questions.explanation: With 'I', we use 'have' + Past Participle (V3) in the Present Perfect.
questions.explanationAr: مع 'I'، نستخدم 'have' + التصريف الثالث (V3) في المضارع التام.

questions.text: She _____ visited Paris.
questions.explanation: With 'She', we use 'has' + Past Participle (V3).
questions.explanationAr: مع 'She'، نستخدم 'has' + التصريف الثالث (V3).

questions.text: What is the past participle (V3) of 'go'?
questions.explanation: The forms of 'go' are: go (V1), went (V2), gone (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تصريفات 'go' هي: go (V1), went (V2), gone (V3).

questions.text: What is the past participle (V3) of 'eat'?
questions.explanation: The forms of 'eat' are: eat (V1), ate (V2), eaten (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تصريفات 'eat' هي: eat (V1), ate (V2), eaten (V3).

questions.text: What is the past participle (V3) of 'see'?
questions.explanation: The forms of 'see' are: see (V1), saw (V2), seen (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تصريفات 'see' هي: see (V1), saw (V2), seen (V3).

questions.text: What is the past participle (V3) of 'write'?
questions.explanation: The forms of 'write' are: write (V1), wrote (V2), written (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تصريفات 'write' هي: write (V1), wrote (V2), written (V3).

questions.text: What is the past participle (V3) of 'take'?
questions.explanation: The forms of 'take' are: take (V1), took (V2), taken (V3).
questions.explanationAr: تصريفات 'take' هي: take (V1), took (V2), taken (V3).

questions.text: I _____ not seen the movie.
questions.explanation: The negative form for 'I' is 'have not' (haven't).
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي لـ 'I' هي 'have not' (haven't).

questions.text: He _____ not done the work.
questions.explanation: The negative form for 'He' is 'has not' (hasn't).
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي لـ 'He' هي 'has not' (hasn't).

questions.text: _____ you visited the museum?
questions.explanation: Questions with 'you' start with 'Have'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة مع 'you' تبدأ بـ 'Have'.

questions.text: _____ she finished her homework?
questions.explanation: Questions with 'she' start with 'Has'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة مع 'she' تبدأ بـ 'Has'.

questions.text: Have you ever been to Dubai? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I have'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالإيجاب هي 'Yes, I have'.

questions.text: Has she seen that movie? No, she _____.
questions.explanation: The short negative answer for 'she' is 'No, she hasn't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالنفي لـ 'she' هي 'No, she hasn't'.

questions.text: Which word is a signal word for the Present Perfect?
questions.explanation: Signal words include: just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for.
questions.explanationAr: الكلمات الدالة تشمل: just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for.

questions.text: I have known him _____ 2010.
questions.explanation: We use 'since' with a specific point in time (2010).
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم 'since' مع نقطة زمنية محددة (2010).

questions.text: She has lived here _____ five years.
questions.explanation: We use 'for' with a period or duration of time (five years).
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم 'for' مع فترة أو مدة زمنية (five years).

questions.text: I have _____ finished my homework.
questions.explanation: 'just' means a very short time ago and is often used between have/has and V3.
questions.explanationAr: كلمة 'just' تعني قبل وقت قصير جداً وغالباً ما تستخدم بين have/has و V3.

questions.text: Have you _____ been to London?
questions.explanation: 'ever' is used in questions to ask about life experiences.
questions.explanationAr: كلمة 'ever' تستخدم في الأسئلة للسؤال عن تجارب الحياة.

questions.text: I haven't finished my project _____.
questions.explanation: 'yet' is used in negative sentences and questions, usually at the end.
questions.explanationAr: كلمة 'yet' تستخدم في الجمل المنفية والأسئلة، وعادة في النهاية.

questions.text: He has _____ been to Spain; this is his first time.
questions.explanation: 'never' means 'not at any time before' and is used in affirmative sentences.
questions.explanationAr: كلمة 'never' تعني 'ليس في أي وقت مضى' وتستخدم في الجمل المثبتة.

questions.text: 'I seen the movie.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use 'have' with the past participle: 'I have seen the movie.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. يجب استخدام 'have' مع التصريف الثالث: 'I have seen the movie.'

questions.text: 'She has went to school.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. 'went' is V2. The correct V3 is 'gone': 'She has gone to school.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. 'went' هو V2. التصريف الثالث الصحيح هو 'gone': 'She has gone to school.'

questions.text: 'Have you saw him?' is a correct question.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use V3 (seen) after have/has: 'Have you seen him?'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. يجب استخدام V3 (seen) بعد have/has: 'Have you seen him?'

questions.text: 'I have not saw it.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. The correct negative form uses V3: 'I haven't seen it.'
questions.explanationAr: هذا غير صحيح. صيغة النفي الصحيحة تستخدم V3: 'I haven't seen it.'

questions.text: 'She has finished her work.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is correct. It properly uses 'has' + V3 (finished).
questions.explanationAr: هذا صحيح. لقد استخدمت 'has' + V3 (finished) بشكل صحيح.
